title: 合规自检：白名单裁剪与敏感字段拦截
expected_output:
=== robots_ok=True 时的逐条检查 ===
落盘 4 条, 被拒 0 条
落盘字段 : ['price', 'shop_name', 'sold_count', 'title', 'url']
说明: 白名单裁剪先于敏感字段检查 -> B 的 phone、C 的 real_name 在裁剪阶段就被丢掉
      所以正常配置下, 敏感字段根本进不到第二道闸; 这是期望行为

=== 若把机密字段也放进白名单(错误示范) ===
  仍被拦住 : 命中个人信息字段, 拒绝落盘: ['phone']

=== robots_ok=False: 前置开关, 不是提醒 ===
   未通过 robots.txt 检查, 禁止采集

=== 检查清单 ===
  1. robots.txt 判定是前置开关(不通过直接抛错)
  2. 字段用白名单裁剪, 不用黑名单
  3. 个人信息字段拒绝落盘, 而不是'记个日志'
  4. 不绕过技术措施(破解验证码/签名/访问控制) —— 绝对红线
code:
# 合规自检: 把"人该记得的事"变成"程序会拦住的事"

ALLOWED_FIELDS = {"title", "price", "url", "shop_name", "sold_count"}   # 白名单
PERSONAL_FIELDS = {"phone", "id_card", "address", "real_name", "location"}

class Guard:
    def __init__(self, robots_ok, allowed=ALLOWED_FIELDS):
        self.robots_ok = robots_ok
        self.allowed = allowed
        self.rejected = []

    def check(self, record):
        if not self.robots_ok:
            raise RuntimeError("未通过 robots.txt 检查, 禁止采集")
        out = {k: v for k, v in record.items() if k in self.allowed}     # 白名单裁剪
        leaked = PERSONAL_FIELDS & set(out)
        if leaked:
            self.rejected.append((record.get("title"), sorted(leaked)))
            raise ValueError("命中个人信息字段, 拒绝落盘: %s" % sorted(leaked))
        return out

records = [
    {"title": "A", "price": 10, "url": "/a", "shop_name": "店1", "sold_count": 5},
    {"title": "B", "price": 20, "phone": "138****", "url": "/b"},
    {"title": "C", "price": 30, "real_name": "张三", "url": "/c"},
    {"title": "D", "price": 40, "url": "/d", "sold_count": 8},
]

print("=== robots_ok=True 时的逐条检查 ===")
g = Guard(robots_ok=True)
kept = []
for r in records:
    try:
        kept.append(g.check(r))
    except ValueError as e:
        print("  拒绝 %-3s : %s" % (r.get("title"), e))
print("落盘 %d 条, 被拒 %d 条" % (len(kept), len(g.rejected)))
print("落盘字段 :", sorted(kept[0].keys()))
print("说明: 白名单裁剪先于敏感字段检查 -> B 的 phone、C 的 real_name 在裁剪阶段就被丢掉")
print("      所以正常配置下, 敏感字段根本进不到第二道闸; 这是期望行为")

print("")
print("=== 若把机密字段也放进白名单(错误示范) ===")
bad_guard = Guard(robots_ok=True, allowed=ALLOWED_FIELDS | {"phone"})
try:
    bad_guard.check({"title": "E", "price": 1, "phone": "139****"})
    print("  没有被拦住 —— 说明白名单一旦放宽, 敏感字段就会漏出")
except ValueError as e:
    print("  仍被拦住 :", e)

print("")
print("=== robots_ok=False: 前置开关, 不是提醒 ===")
try:
    Guard(robots_ok=False).check(records[0])
except RuntimeError as e:
    print("  ", e)

print("")
print("=== 检查清单 ===")
print("  1. robots.txt 判定是前置开关(不通过直接抛错)")
print("  2. 字段用白名单裁剪, 不用黑名单")
print("  3. 个人信息字段拒绝落盘, 而不是'记个日志'")
print("  4. 不绕过技术措施(破解验证码/签名/访问控制) —— 绝对红线")
